values.en: For an arc-length parametrized curve $\gamma$ with $\gamma''\neq 0$, the **torsion** of $\gamma$ is the function $\tau$ characterized by $\boldsymbol{b}'(s)=\tau(s)\,\boldsymbol{n}(s)$ for every value $s$ of the arc-length parameter, that is $\boldsymbol{b}'=\tau\,\boldsymbol{n}$. Since $\boldsymbol{b}$ is a unit vector field, $\boldsymbol{b}'\perp\boldsymbol{b}$; and since $\boldsymbol{t},\boldsymbol{n},\boldsymbol{b}$ is an orthonormal frame, $\boldsymbol{b}'$ must be a multiple of $\boldsymbol{n}$. Hence such a $\tau$ exists and is unique, and equivalently $\tau=\langle\boldsymbol{b}',\boldsymbol{n}\rangle$. The torsion measures how fast the osculating plane rotates along the curve; $\tau\equiv 0$ exactly when $\gamma$ is planar.
values.zh-CN: 对满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的曲线 $\gamma$，**挠率**是由 $\boldsymbol{b}'(s)=\tau(s)\,\boldsymbol{n}(s)$ 刻画的函数 $\tau$，即在弧长参数 $s$ 的每个取值处成立，亦即 $\boldsymbol{b}'=\tau\,\boldsymbol{n}$。由于 $\boldsymbol{b}$ 是单位向量场，$\boldsymbol{b}'\perp\boldsymbol{b}$；又因 $\boldsymbol{t},\boldsymbol{n},\boldsymbol{b}$ 是正交标架，$\boldsymbol{b}'$ 必为 $\boldsymbol{n}$ 的倍数。故这样的 $\tau$ 存在且唯一，等价地 $\tau=\langle\boldsymbol{b}',\boldsymbol{n}\rangle$。挠率度量密切平面沿曲线转动的快慢；$\tau\equiv 0$ 恰好对应于 $\gamma$ 是平面曲线。
